SELECT singer.Name, singer.Country
FROM singer
JOIN singer_in_concert ON singer.Singer_ID = singer_in_concert.Singer_ID
WHERE singer_in_concert.concert_ID IN (
    SELECT concert.concert_ID
    FROM concert
    JOIN singer_in_concert ON concert.concert_ID = singer_in_concert.concert_ID
    WHERE concert.concert_Name LIKE '%Hey%'
)
SELECT StuID FROM Has_Pet WHERE LName = 'Smith';

SELECT StuID, PetID, PetType, pet_age, weight
FROM Has_Pet
JOIN Pets ON Has_Pet.PetID = Pets.PetID
JOIN Student ON Has_Pet.StuID = Student.StuID
WHERE Student.StuID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY StuID, PetID, PetType, pet_age, weight
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

SELECT airports.AirportCode
FROM airports
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights
       WHERE flights.Airline = airports.Airline
         AND flights.SourceAirport = airports.City
         AND flights.DestAirport = airports.City
       ) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights
           WHERE flights.Airline = airports.Airline
             AND flights.SourceAirport = airports.City
             AND flights.DestAirport = airports.City
       )

SELECT Airline
FROM airlines
WHERE Airline NOT IN (
    SELECT Airline
    FROM flights
    WHERE SourceAirport = 'CVO' OR DestAirport = 'APG'
);
